findings.body: The declaration format promised by this task cannot represent existing argument converters. `close --dismiss` uses `type=int` at `src/forge/cli.py:49`; placing its equivalent argument tuple in `COMMANDS` makes `ast.literal_eval` raise `ValueError` on the `int` name during parser construction, breaking every invocation, including `--help`. The current command works only because it remains in `TABLE`. Support existing converter values in the collector and extend the real-CLI fixture test to exercise a typed argument. This can be completed within COLLECTOR's scope without waiting for COMMANDS.
